result.answer: A resend would have moved the patient in the bed-management system from WARD-C bed BAY1-07 to WARD-B bed BAY2-04, taking the record from version 2 to version 3. The bed manager's transfer to WARD-C at the same moment (08:20 UTC) would be overwritten. The services that read this record would follow the change. The bed board would free the WARD-C bed. Pharmacy would send medicines to WARD-B. Porters would get a move task. The patient record would show WARD-B. If the bed manager's placement is the right one, this means a wrong bed, medicines going to the wrong ward and an unneeded porter move. The resend's safety check would not prevent this, because version 2 is still current. Not acting leaves WARD-C in place. If the patient really went to WARD-B, those same services stay wrong. Neither event is later than the other, and no source is named as authoritative, so the evidence can't say which outcome is correct. Shutter can't see what those services show now. W1: if the site named the bed manager as authoritative, this case would have closed with no write. That setting is not in place now.
